input: Shred five years of old financial documents at home

gold.taskTitle: Shred five years of old financial documents at home
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to shred five years worth of accumulated financial documents at home and needs a clear plan to do so.

questions.title: Do you own a shredder or need to get one?
questions.description: Understand whether the user already has a shredder available at home or needs to purchase or borrow one.

questions.title: How many boxes or bags of documents are there?
questions.description: Estimate the volume of documents to gauge how much time and shredder capacity will be needed.

questions.title: Which document types are included in this pile?
questions.description: Identify the specific types of financial documents such as bank statements, tax returns, pay stubs, or receipts.

questions.title: Are any documents still needed before being shredded?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to review or scan any documents for record-keeping before destruction.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this task?
questions.description: Find out if there is a specific date or urgency driving this task, such as a move or tax season.

questions.title: Do staples, paper clips, or binders need to be removed first?
questions.description: Clarify whether documents are bound together in ways that require preparation before shredding.

questions.title: Where will the shredded material be disposed of afterward?
questions.description: Understand the user's plan for disposing of shredded paper, such as recycling bin, trash, or a secure collection service.
